message: a `precondition` block must be the first statement of a function or constructor body: it guards the generated encrypted-input conversions, which are inserted directly after it
a function may declare at most one `precondition` block

a `precondition` block is only permitted on a function or constructor that declares at least one dialect-managed encrypted input (`in eT`); without one there is nothing for it to guard — use a plain block or a modifier
